run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend since 2026-11-15T05:52:17Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The RequestErrorRate warning on otel-demo/frontend is explained by a rollout of the adservice and paymentservice Deployments at 2026-11-15T05:50:43Z on single-replica workloads whose containers have no readiness or startup probes. The only adservice pod was replaced and its new pod started at 05:50:45Z, but the service process did not log 'Ad service started, listening on 8080' until 05:57:04Z while being throttled on roughly 90-94% of CFS periods at its 50m CPU limit, so the ad Service ClusterIP (100.65.180.246:8080) had no listening backend. Frontend calls to grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds failed with 'connect: connection refused' and /api/data returned HTTP 500; the same rollout pattern on paymentservice made 100.70.188.60:8080 refuse connections, so checkout PlaceOrder failed with rpc code 13 'failed to charge card ... connection refused' and /api/checkout returned 500. frontend ERROR spans rose from 0 to a peak of about 3.98 spans/s at the 05:56:17Z evaluation and fell back to 0 by 06:03:17Z. adservice and paymentservice themselves recorded no error spans and payment completed charges normally once reachable, so this was an endpoint-availability gap, not an application error in those services. The alert annotation's stated current error-rate value (2.5777777777777775) is alert-payload context, not tool-verified request-level data.

claims.text: frontend was the largest error-span contributor in the window: increase over 76m of traces_span_metrics_calls_total{service_name="frontend",status_code="STATUS_CODE_ERROR"} was 1734.53 spans, versus frontend-proxy 884.03, checkout 69.67, fraud-detection 3.05, recommendation 4.06, ad 1.02 and 0 for accounting, cart and payment.

frontend error spans in the window were concentrated in two call chains: GET, GET /api/data, 'executing api route (pages) /api/data' and grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds each had 387.145 error spans over 76m, while POST, POST /api/checkout, 'executing api route (pages) /api/checkout' and grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder each had 42.677; tcp.connect had 15.24 error spans.

The 5-minute error-span rate of frontend was 0 up to the 05:51:17Z evaluation, first non-zero (0.337 spans/s) at 05:52:17Z, peaked at 3.98 spans/s at 05:56:17Z, and returned to 0 from the 06:03:17Z evaluation through the last returned point at 06:05:17Z; checkout's rate was non-zero only at the 05:53:17-05:57:17Z evaluations.

Frontend error details name connection refused to the ad and payment service ClusterIPs: 'executing api route (pages) /api/data' carries '14 UNAVAILABLE: No connection established. Last error: connect ECONNREFUSED 100.65.180.246:8080', and 'executing api route (pages) /api/checkout' carries '13 INTERNAL: failed to charge card: ... dial tcp 100.70.188.60:8080: connect: connection refused' with HTTP status 500 on the POST/POST /api/checkout spans.
Kubernetes Services ad and payment expose ClusterIP 100.65.180.246:8080 and 100.70.188.60:8080 respectively, matching the refused destinations in the frontend error text.

checkout's own outbound span oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge has status rpc.grpc.status_code=14 with otel.status_description 'connection error: desc = "transport: Error while dialing: dial tcp 100.70.188.60:8080: connect: connection refused"', and its oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder spans are ERROR with rpc.grpc.status_code=13 and status description 'failed to charge card: could not charge the card: ... connection refused'.

The ad and payment Deployments were rolled out at 05:50:43Z: Deployment ad scaled new ReplicaSet ad-6cb57f76d from 0 to 1 (05:50:43Z) and old ReplicaSet ad-554b849958 from 1 to 0 (05:50:46Z); Deployment payment scaled payment-9c8ffb665 from 0 to 1 (05:50:43Z) and payment-55766d76b9 from 1 to 0 (05:50:47Z), with SuccessfulCreate/SuccessfulDelete and Started events for the new pods.

Current pods ad-6cb57f76d-xmcq6 and payment-9c8ffb665-qrm84 started at 05:50:43Z with 0 restarts and are Running/ready; the other 19 otel-demo pods started 05:16:58-05:18:40Z, so only ad and payment were replaced at 05:50.

The replacement ad container started at 05:50:45Z but the application logged 'Ad service starting.' only at 05:55:10Z and 'Ad service started, listening on 8080' at 05:57:04Z, about 6m19s after container start.

ad's server span oteldemo.AdService/GetAds shows 0 spans in the per-minute increase at the 05:53, 05:54, 05:57, 05:58 and 05:59 evaluations (the 05:55 and 05:56 evaluation points were not returned) and resumes at 144 spans in the 06:00 minute; frontend's client span grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds shows errors only at 05:52-05:59 with zero STATUS_CODE_UNSET (successful) spans at 05:53-05:59, and success resumes at 06:00 (110 spans).

The new ad pod ad-6cb57f76d-xmcq6 was throttled on 0.90-0.94 of its CFS periods from the 05:52Z through 05:58Z evaluations and consumed about 0.049 CPU cores, i.e. at its 50m cpu limit; the previous ad pod ad-554b849958-mbnxm was throttled only 0.07-0.12 with about 0.004 cores.

The ad and payment Deployment container specs define no readinessProbe and no startupProbe, with limits cpu 50m/20m and requests cpu 10m/10m and image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-ad / -payment; both Deployments use strategy RollingUpdate with maxSurge 25% / maxUnavailable 25% at replicas 1 and report Available=True and Progressing=True, and their Services' Endpoints now list the new pods (100.96.4.142 and 100.96.4.221 on port 8080).

The new payment pod's earliest retained log lines in the window are 'Charge request received.' / 'Transaction complete.' from 05:52:31Z onward, and payment's own spans show no error status (oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge and 'charge' 1142.59 spans STATUS_CODE_UNSET, GET/tcp.connect/dns.lookup error counts 0).

frontend-proxy recorded 884.03 error spans over 76m (ingress 454.21, 'router frontend egress' 429.82) and its 500 spans have visible parent references ingress -> router frontend egress -> frontend GET span with http.status_code 500, i.e. the proxy spans report frontend's 500 responses.

No node-level or container-level failure is visible for the replacement pods: all 5 nodes report Ready=True with MemoryPressure/DiskPressure/PIDPressure=False, and the otel-demo events in the window contain only the Killing/SuccessfulDelete/SuccessfulCreate/Scheduled/Pulled/Created/Started/ScalingReplicaSet records for ad and payment, with no Evicted, OOMKilled or Unhealthy events.

Primary cause: the 05:50:43Z rolling replacement of the single adservice pod, combined with the absence of a readiness probe (so the pod was marked ready as soon as the container started), left Service ad (100.65.180.246:8080) pointing at a process that was still starting and throttled on its 50m CPU limit. ad did not listen until 05:57:04Z, so frontend's /api/data calls got ECONNREFUSED, returned HTTP 500 and drove the frontend error rate on which RequestErrorRate fired.

Secondary, contributing cause: the same update replaced the single paymentservice pod at 05:50:47Z without a readiness probe; payment's first completed charge appears at 05:52:31Z, and during that gap checkout's oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge calls were refused at 100.70.188.60:8080, producing checkout PlaceOrder rpc-13 errors and the frontend /api/checkout 500 slice (42.677 error spans per span name).

Deeper mechanism for the long ad outage: the 50m cpu limit is too small for the adservice JVM startup. CPU usage of the new ad pod sat at about 0.049 cores (its limit) with 90-94% of CFS periods throttled during 05:52-05:58Z, while the steady-state old pod used about 0.004 cores with 7-12% throttling; the start line appeared 4m25s after container start and listening 6m19s after. This is consistent with CPU-limit-induced slow start but was not proven by a throttle-to-startup timing breakdown.

Rejected: adservice returning application errors. ad's own span group oteldemo.AdService/GetAds has 1419.69 spans with STATUS_CODE_UNSET and no ERROR status; the only ad error series is 1.02 spans on flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/EventStream, whose per-minute activity (about 0.0037 spans/s) sits at the 05:44-05:47Z evaluations, before frontend's error rate became non-zero at 05:52:17Z.

Rejected: paymentservice failing internally. payment recorded 0 error spans of its own (charge and oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge 1142.59 STATUS_CODE_UNSET, GET/tcp.connect/dns.lookup error counts 0) and its pod logs show 'Transaction complete.' for each charge; the failures were connection-level refusals recorded by the caller checkout.

Rejected: node pressure or pod eviction/OOM as the cause. All 5 nodes report Ready=True with MemoryPressure, DiskPressure and PIDPressure False, and the incident-window events for otel-demo contain no Evicted, OOMKilled or Unhealthy records, only normal rollout events.

frontend-proxy is not an independent failing component: its ingress and 'router frontend egress' 500 spans carry parent references to frontend's own GET spans with http.status_code 500, and its per-minute error rate was a low baseline (about 0.004-0.015 spans/s) before the 05:52Z burst, then tracked frontend's burst and returned to 0 at 06:01-06:02Z.

Add readinessProbe/startupProbe (and consider minReadySeconds and maxUnavailable: 0) to the ad and payment containers so a replacement pod is only added to Service endpoints after it is listening; with replicas=1, maxUnavailable 25% and no readiness probe, the old pod was scaled down 3 s after the new pod was created while the new process was still starting.

Raise the adservice CPU limit above 50m or give its JVM a larger startup budget, since the replacement pod was throttled on about 90-94% of CFS periods while pinned at its 50m cpu limit during startup.

gaps: What triggered the 05:50:43Z rollout of the ad and payment Deployments (config change vs image change) is unknown: the change_history integration is not integrated in this Run, the Deployment revision is 2 for both, and the only image string visible is ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-ad / -payment while the previous pods no longer exist for a digest comparison.

The RequestErrorRate alerting rule could not be read: list_prometheus_rules with rule_name=RequestErrorRate and with match {alertname="RequestErrorRate"} both returned no data (status no_data), so the alert expression, threshold and whether it is still firing after 06:08:36Z are unknown.

Jaeger returned no frontend-proxy traces for 05:52-05:56Z (traces_search 84a39f10-6233-436c-be2d-3879f0978f89-t1:c7268c63-4c7e-4a94-b98a-6bb94b60b1c9 and traces_search_by_tags a2b55e88-f61b-4ebc-9510-e7786ffb290d-t1:ffb3f279-5cb0-4a73-9ce1-313996280c6e both no_data), and the frontend/checkout error samples (b9a2f1b0-21e6-43e9-8ad8-5b2c2d8cde58-t0 and 890706cb-a6d5-46f5-864f-bb24f4f4fbbf-t0, both incomplete and truncated, covering 05:51:40-05:51:51Z) cover only that sub-minute, so the complete call graph and the full span population for the whole burst were not observed.
adservice server-span per-minute increases were not returned at the 05:55Z and 05:56Z evaluation points, so ad traffic during those minutes is unknown rather than zero.

The exact moment paymentservice began accepting connections cannot be pinned: its earliest retained log line in the window is a charge at 05:52:31Z (view 84258760-e999-4ef3-bd80-2692c6a5fd95-t1 is incomplete: newest 40 of 85 lines shown), and whether it listened earlier without being called is unknown; the payment log filter query 7dbe3f76-a1d5-4dc3-ab06-d83ee93bea03-t1:0a561ecd-f59a-4ee5-8262-336269b32d9c returned no_data.

Request-level error-rate telemetry (http_server_request_duration_seconds_count) returned no series for the window (8cd7dddb-da6b-4c84-8b05-448cc8ed112e-t1:da7efe0a-1439-4f16-9cab-e281f8bd7bf4 status no_data), so the alert annotation's current value 2.5777777777777775 could not be reproduced from request-level metrics.
next_steps: Review the deployment/CI history for the otel-demo ad and payment Deployments around 2026-11-15T05:50:43Z (change history is not integrated here) to identify the change that triggered revision 2.

Validate the recommendation to add readiness/startup probes and a higher adservice CPU limit in a non-production overlay, then confirm that a rollout of these single-replica Deployments no longer produces refused connections.
Check Alertmanager for the current state of the RequestErrorRate alert for otel-demo/frontend, since the observed frontend error-span rate had returned to 0 by the 06:03:17Z evaluation.
